assertions.text: Identifies quote_price holding and serialising money as a binary float
assertions.evidence: Cites money_conversion.py:16-20 — subtotal, tax, and total computed as floats and emitted as JSON numbers.

assertions.text: Identifies the consumer's Decimal sum disagreeing with the float sum

assertions.evidence: Cites lines 28-29 against line 35 — a factor of 10,000 out against a divisor of 10, a 1000x error between the two sides of the same conversion.

assertions.text: Identifies apply_discount truncating with int() rather than rounding
assertions.evidence: Cites lines 39-40 — int() on a float division discards the remainder, so every discount is systematically short.

assertions.text: Failure scenario names every invoice disagreeing with its own line items

assertions.text: Fix recommends a fixed-precision decimal carried as a string with an agreed scale
assertions.evidence: Fix: a decimal type on both sides, serialised as a string with an agreed scale and currency, and an explicit rounding mode at the one place rounding is required.
